anomalies.observed: C8 is defined as a 0.1 uF unpolarized capacitor (libsource Device/C), but it is assigned an inductor footprint, Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder. Its pin 2 is tied to GND while pin 1 is on a single-node unconnected net.
anomalies.expected: A capacitor should use a capacitor footprint and, if populated, both pads should be connected to the intended net pair. The specification does not describe C8, so standard practice requires a populated bypass/decoupling capacitor to be connected and footprint-consistent.
anomalies.impact: If C8 was intended as a decoupling capacitor, it cannot function because one pad is floating; the inductor footprint also suggests a possible sourcing or assembly error.
